zh-CN.title: 聊天图片加载更可靠
items: 刚发送或从其他设备同步到的聊天图片现在会自动重试，无需刷新页面即可恢复
本地图片预览不可用时会自动切换到云端资源

en.title: More reliable chat image loading
items: Newly sent and cross-device chat images now retry automatically without requiring a page refresh
Unavailable local previews now fall back to the cloud copy automatically
